Title: Desc
Chat Room Customization: You can pick custom background images and background music for your room here by loading external resources. Note that players need to enable those customizations manually.

Title: TitleMusicLibrary
Chat Room Customization: This is a selection of copyright free music you can use.

Title: BackgroundImageNote
Chat Room Customization: You can use game resources as well, like https://bondageprojects.com/images/school.jpg or Screens/Room/Platform/Background/Savannah/TentInterior.jpg

Title: BackgroundSizeModeFillOriginalRatio
Chat Room Customization: Fill the room, original aspect ratio

Title: BackgroundFilterNote
Chat Room Customization: You can put a color filter that will go over your background.  For example, use #00000080 to dim the lights.

Title: BackgroundMusicNote
Chat Room Customization: Put the address of the background mp3 music file to use.

Title: BackgroundMusicSync
Chat Room Customization: Synchronize music track across the room
